decisions.reason: The DPA management software is a multi-model product line on its own page, closely tied to the firm's announced compliance and agency focus, and it has positive agency feedback, so the investment and public commitment favor persistence.

The hosting management platform is featured on the home page and is central to the announced expansion of agency-focused platform features, making it a highly visible and heavily invested core commitment.

The configurable managed hosting plan sits close to the core business on owned infrastructure, costs little to keep, and has its own page, so any weak early results can be attributed to normal ramp-up.
